overview.goal: Interactive ML research & diagnostic suite for classifying problem scenarios into Supervised, Unsupervised, or Reinforcement Learning paradigms with CoT reasoning, token-probability confidence, zero-shot vs few-shot vs DistilBERT comparisons, Keras training simulation, and responsible AI governance.
overview.target_audience: ML Researchers, AI Engineers, Students, Technical Decision Makers

pages.name: Paradigm Classifier
pages.description: Enter or select a problem scenario -> see step-by-step Chain of Thought (CoT) reasoning, predicted paradigm label (Supervised / Unsupervised / Reinforcement Learning), recommended algorithms, token-probability confidence bars, side-by-side LLM vs DistilBERT comparison, and dynamic pipeline workflow diagram.

pages.name: Synthetic Dataset (200 Scenarios)
pages.description: Explore and generate 200 synthetic problem scenarios categorized across 6 domains (Healthcare, Finance, Robotics, E-commerce, Vision, NLP). Features searchable grid, domain filtering, complexity tags, and sample data viewer.

pages.name: Keras DistilBERT Fine-Tuning
pages.description: Simulated Keras DistilBERT fine-tuning control center with epoch-by-epoch progress, dynamic loss/accuracy line charts, hyperparameter controls (learning rate, batch size, epochs), and weight layer metrics.

pages.name: 20-Scenario Benchmark & Eval
pages.description: Rigorous evaluation suite comparing Zero-Shot LLM, Few-Shot LLM, and Fine-Tuned DistilBERT on 20 hand-labeled scenarios. Includes per-domain radar/bar charts, failure case analysis, latency benchmarks, and statistical error matrix.

pages.name: ML Foundations & Attention
pages.description: Interactive educational hub featuring the complete ML Lifecycle Diagram, Generative vs Discriminative framing comparator, and step-by-step Transformer Multi-Head Attention visual explainer (Q, K, V dot product matrix).

pages.name: Responsible AI & Model Card
pages.description: Governance dashboard spotlighting domain bias analysis, input safety guardrail tester, synthetic data limitation disclosure, open-source license note, and official DistilBERT Model Card tabbed view.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

layout_and_spacing.padding_philosophy: Generous spacing. Internal container padding MUST use p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision against borders.
layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: Bento High Density Grid for analytics; Tactical Tetris layout for scenario cards.
layout_and_spacing.header: Fixed top navigation bar with blur effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800 z-50), brand logo, navigation tabs, theme status, and quick scenario trigger.

components_and_ui.shadcn_usage: Use Shadcn components for Tabs, Progress, Dialog, Accordion, Select, Tooltip, Badge, Table, Slider, and Switch. Heavily custom styled with Tailwind dark void classes.
components_and_ui.charting_library: Recharts for loss/accuracy line charts, domain accuracy radar/bar charts, confidence distributions, and latency bars.
components_and_ui.illustrations: Custom animated SVG diagrams for ML Lifecycle, Pipeline Workflow, Transformer Attention Matrices, and Neural Network topology.

image_urls.description: Network graph visualization for header background accents
Abstract neural node sphere for Model Card and Foundations page

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: EVERY interactive element, button, tab, input, metric card, scenario row, chart container, and modal MUST contain a descriptive data-testid in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: All text elements must meet WCAG AA contrast (minimum 4.5:1 ratio). Hover states must explicitly state text color (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the code uses JS / JSX format as configured in frontend directory.
Ensure all 6 key requirement sections are rich, functional, interactive, and pre-populated with realistic ML scenarios and metrics.
Implement real-time interactive state management for scenario classification, custom text input, training simulation, synthetic dataset filtering, and guardrail testing.
Ensure Sonner toasts notify the user on scenario analysis, model training actions, data export, and safety guardrail flags.
Make heavy use of clear data structures containing 200 synthetic scenarios and 20 hand-labeled gold benchmark scenarios so all charts and tables render rich statistical data.
Strictly follow the dark mode styling with cyan, amber, emerald, and violet color coding for machine learning paradigms and model types.
